state.context: The business specification asks invoices to renew with genuine consent, retry definite transient failures within a finite policy, and revoke outdated checkout access while keeping uncertain money visible. PaymentsV1 currently supports collect/refund/reconcile, four states and a nullable checkout link; the only direct source consumer is CanInvoice. Runtime and vendor code remain out of scope.
state.candidate: The reviewed design uses collect(customer,amount,reference,consent=null) and a new cancel(reference) with the same PaymentState as refund and reconcile. Absent consent selects an interactive payment; supplied consent requests off-session use. Actual collection must verify current merchant/team/customer ownership, permitted currency/amount and authorization lifetime/scope. Unsupported or withdrawn permission becomes a definite action_required failure. Preflight eligibility could be queried separately but would not authorize the later collection. Receipt metadata adds an increasing attempt revision and an optional failed-only enum with transient, action_required, permanent and cancelled. Disabling checkout never turns already accepted uncertainty into failure; cancel stays pending/unknown until known, and cancelled asserts no debit. Later authenticated contradictory success is retained for review. A stable reference cannot be rebound to new inputs.

consent.instructions: Select the consent API boundary that remains authoritative with the least unnecessary surface.

criteria.dispatch: Make collect itself validate the supplied customer/consent and report action_required where needed; use its existing interactive mode for customer recovery.
criteria.preflight: Provide both a consent eligibility read and collect-time enforcement; this offers advance explanations at the cost of extra API and stale-read semantics.

retry_contract.instructions: Are revisioned outcomes with these failure and cancellation meanings adequate for a separately authored invoice retry policy to avoid confusing transient failure, required interaction and still-uncertain money?
